name: gaia-ai-workforce
description: Powered by the Gaia WFM workforce management platform, this connector brings common workforce workflows—including attendance inquiries, scheduling, leave, missed-punch corrections, and overtime requests—into GWork. Use natural language to query personal and team attendance data, automatically validate applicable rules, and submit requests for approval in one step, without signing in to Gaia WFM and completing each task manually.

cn.gourd.gwork.readme:
## 盖雅 AI 人效专家 CLI 连接器

厂商官方 `@gaiaworks/gaia-cli@1.0.5`，扫码/浏览器授权，内置 11 套官方技能。

### 连接方式

1. 点击「连接」，GWork 自动准备 Node 运行时并安装官方 CLI；
2. 弹窗展示授权链接/二维码，按厂商页面完成扫码或浏览器确认；
3. 授权完成后自动连接。凭据由官方 CLI 自管，GWork 不接触 token。

技能包来源：厂商公开 CLI 包随附技能文档（公开仓库缓存副本）；许可见各技能目录 LICENSE。
